# maths_utils

Source: [`flow/models/maths_utils.py`](../../flow/models/maths_utils.py)

Gauss-Legendre quadrature over the loop momentum q and angle theta (NumPy).

## Symbols

### `GaussLegendre`

```
GaussLegendre(wq: np.ndarray, yq: np.ndarray)
```

Calculates integral of yq with the Gauss-Legendre method.

#### Parameters

- `wq` (np.ndarray): Gauss-Legendre weights corresponding to the q-grid.
- `yq` (np.ndarray): a function y(q) on the q-grid.

#### Returns

- integral of y(q) over q.

### `GaussLegendre2D_NLO`

```
GaussLegendre2D_NLO(wq: np.ndarray, wtheta: np.ndarray, gq: np.ndarray, Fpwqt: np.ndarray)
```

Calculates integral of Fpwqt*gq with the Gauss-Legendre method.

#### Parameters

- `wq` (np.ndarray): Gauss-Legendre weights corresponding to the q-grid.
- `wtheta` (np.ndarray): Gauss-Legendre weights corresponding to the theta-grid.
- `gq` (np.ndarray): array of g(q) values on q-grid.
- `Fpwqt` (np.ndarray): array of F(p,w,q,theta) values on p,w,q,theta-grids.

#### Returns

- `Ipw` (np.ndarray): integral of g(q)*F(p,w,q,theta) over q and theta (2D array of values on p,w grids).
